note: B25 Office de tourisme, ground floor: the hall of the world (Le hall du monde), camera at the entrance looking in. Sage-green walls, navy wainscot, white pilasters, grey-oak floor with an inlaid navy compass rose; landmark: the relief landscape model table under the big arched window. Feminine LEFT: girl in a yellow dress cranking the Ferris wheel of a toy town (ville); giraffe in a tall red cap beside the Eiffel Tower model (capitale); green parrot holding up a blue passport for the clerk's rubber stamp (nationalité). Masculine RIGHT: mole on the earthy globe mound (monde); raccoon behind a striped border barrier with a pennant (pays); beaver smoothing a town map on a plank bench (plan); grandmother in a traffic-cone hat at the floor jigsaw of continents (continent); penguin in a tub of soap suds (sud); bear-cub cowboy on a rocking horse (ouest). Exits: blue front door far left -> B25_monde; doorway in the right wall -> map room R_abs_space_01; staircase back right up -> R_world_02; zoom on the relief model -> R_world_01_z1. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
